title: How to Start a Weekly Podcast From Your Closet
text:
Starting a weekly podcast from a spare closet costs less than most people think. Clothes absorb echo, so a closet studio beats an empty bedroom for recording quality.

Before you buy anything, pick a topic you can talk about for fifty episodes without running dry.

Step 1: Buy a dynamic USB microphone and a boom arm, because microphone quality matters most.
Step 2: Hang a thick blanket behind your chair and close the closet door to kill the echo.
Step 3: Record a short test episode and listen on phone speakers before recording more.
Step 4: Trim mistakes, level the loudness, and export the finished audio as an MP3 file.
Step 5: Upload each episode to a hosting service that submits your feed to every major podcast app.
Step 6: Publish on a fixed weekly day so subscribers learn when new episodes arrive.

Consistency matters more than expensive gear. Keep notes after each episode and fix one small thing per week.
reference: Set up a closet studio with a USB microphone, record short test episodes, and publish on a fixed weekly day.
